text:
Gina (sales): Quick help 10am SG POC. Customer pinned model "redwood-ultra-v2"; calls from ap-sg return MODEL_NOT_FOUND then 429s. Need triage + 14-day dedicated trial price + short security answers. Logs below.

Arjun (se): Paste the exact request and error lines? Did they pin by name or manifest id?

Gina (sales): They used literal: "model: "redwood-ultra-v2"". Proxy snippet:
[2026-11-21T09:02:11Z] req=cc101 model=redwood-ultra-v2 region=ap-sg status=404 err=MODEL_NOT_FOUND
[2026-11-21T09:02:12Z] req=cc102 model=redwood-ultra-v2 region=ap-sg status=429 err=NO_FALLBACK

Laila (infra): Likely variant not staged in ap-sg. Fast options: (1) enable account-level alias fallback to deployed compatible variant (redwood-ultra-v2-quant or -compat) or (2) provision a small Dedicated pool (2x A100-eq) for 14 days. Need manifest id for exact artifact push.

Nora (security): Compliance questions: KMS envelope encryption, SOC2 evidence, and regional log residency. Hosted covers SOC2 + encryption; Dedicated/Private needed for strict residency. I can draft a 1-pager.

Arjun (se): Immediate workaround: if customer consents, we map pinned=redwood-ultra-v2 -> redwood-ultra-v2-quant in ap-sg and ask them to set header `x-allow-fallback: 1` for the POC. Note potential perf/quality differences.

Infra-bot: Deployment check:
- redwood-ultra-v2: manifest M-d4f2 deployed: us-west, eu-west
- redwood-ultra-v2-quant: manifest M-d4f2-q deployed: ap-sg (replicas:3)
- redwood-ultra-v2-compat: deployed: ap-sg (replicas:1)

Laila (infra): Confirmed. Alias fallback will unblock in ~60-90 mins after approval. Dedicated ballpark infra cost ~$9k-$12k for 2 GPUs x14d; recommend quoting $17k-$19k including ops/support. Activation for Dedicated ~24-48h.

Gina (sales): Contact: helen.choi@exampleasia.com. I'll ask if they accept fallback and need the security pack and quote asap.

(20 minutes later)

Gina (sales): Customer agreed to try the quant variant for the POC, with a note about possible differences. Please enable fallback.

Laila (infra): Enabling alias now and will run smoke tests.

Infra-bot: Alias rule applied for acct-301: pinned=redwood-ultra-v2 -> redwood-ultra-v2-quant in ap-sg.

Laila (infra): Smoke tests returning 200; monitoring for 429s. Will open a manifest push ticket if customer later requests exact parity.

Deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-4722 "AP-SG POC: alias fallback + trial quote" assigned to infra, se, security. Link: https://internal.redwood/INF-4722

Arjun (se): Action items: Gina to send security 1-pager and the trial quote; Laila to monitor; escalate if 429s recur.

Gina (sales): Thanks all, looping back to customer with the security pack and quote now.
